notes.text: **CTA:** the blue text link (blue label and arrow, `link-primary`), 24px under the content (16px on a card with no icon and no badge). Every card's CTA is blue, so links read the same in any row of cards.

notes.text: **In a row:** cards share the row's height, and the CTA (with the tags or badge above it) sits on the bottom edge, so the links line up across the row however long each card's copy is. notes.was: **Heading:** `h2` (SemiBold 38px), on the content column (up to 1440px), 740px wide at most. A 44px pause button sits at the right.

notes.text: `pauseButton`: `true` (default) · What shows: The 44px pause button at the right of the heading · Use it when: Every page, unless the design calls for a clean heading row

`pauseButton`: `false` · What shows: No button. It comes into view only when it gets keyboard focus, so keyboard and screen reader users can still stop the row · Use it when: The heading row must stay clear, such as a centered heading
With the button hidden, the row still pauses under the pointer and when a logo link has focus, and it stays still for anyone who has reduced motion turned on.

**Hidden pause button (known problem):** WCAG 2.2.2 asks for a visible way to pause anything that moves on its own for more than five seconds. With `pauseButton={false}` the row pauses on hover and stays still with reduced motion, and keyboard users can reach the button, but a mouse user who only wants it to stop has to keep the pointer on it. Keep the button wherever you can.

notes.text: With one or two items there is nothing to scroll to, so the module drops the carousel. The cards share one row and fill the content column (two at half width each, 24px apart; one at the full width), with no progress bar or buttons, and 100px above and below. Each card keeps its size (`lg`, `sm` or `video`) and its height matches the tallest. On phones the cards stack, 16px apart. Three or more quotes always use the carousel.
Use it once per page. A single quote can also be a TestimonialCard on its own in a section.
notes.was: Use it once per page. For a single quote, use a TestimonialCard on its own.

notes.text: **On cards, it's blue.** The call to action that ends a card (Card, ResourceCard, TestimonialCard, HoverCard) is always the blue text link with its arrow, never the neutral one, so links read the same across every row of cards.

Use: **TestimonialCarousel** · When: Customer quotes or video stories. Use the video version when you have recordings. With fewer than three quotes it shows them as cards that fill the row instead of a carousel.

notes.text: Keep one kind of card per row. Mixing a ResourceCard and a BlogCard in one carousel is fine; mixing a Card with a ResourceCard is not. Cards in a row share one height, with their calls to action lined up along the bottom, and a card's text-link CTA is always blue.

notes.text: **Rows of cards** (stat cards, Card Module, profile grids): pick the number across so rows come out full, and never leave one card alone on a row when another number avoids it: five are 3 + 2, not 4 + 1; four on tablet are 2 × 2, not 3 + 1. A row that still comes out short is centered, with its cards at the same width as the rows above. Listings that grow, such as search results or the events grid with Load More, keep their reading order and start each row on the left. A card's text link is always blue (see Buttons and links).
